title: Validate direct-download installs and in-place updates
description: Download each supported executable exactly as a user would, validate checksums and startup, test project-local, user-local, and global-path installations where permissions allow, exercise version/create/claim/export, and prove wtp update safely upgrades an existing binary without changing .wtp behavior.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Added deterministic GoReleaser direct-download QA harness with a local GitHub-compatible fixture. Validated all six assets/checksums, Unix project/user/global-PATH installs, create/claim/export, safe in-place update preserving .wtp, and Windows PowerShell/cross-target coverage. Passed ./scripts/check.sh, goreleaser check, and ./scripts/release_qa.sh.
